verdict.rationale: Netlify gives every PR an isolated Deploy Preview URL, offers shareable preview environments, and lets you run local dev servers from the CLI. Community users confirm the PR preview builds work. That covers testing code changes away from production, but data isolation is thin: the only data-side evidence is the vague claim that Netlify Database lets you "safely iterate on managed Postgres", and team-scoped env vars might separate preview credentials from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of database branching or sandboxed data for previews, per-deploy-context env var or secret scoping that keeps preview data separate from production, and hands-on corroboration that previews don't touch production data.
